newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent holds onto gains in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent holds onto gains in dull trade.

text.p: IPE Brent futures stagnated at earlier higher levels on Tuesday in a quiet, featureless market ahead of the NYMEX open, brooers said.
July Brent was 19 cents higher at $17.75 a barrel at 1134 GMT little changed from its mid-morning levels, while June gas oil was $1.50 up at $161.50 a tonne.
Brokers attributed the gains to a small, corrective bounce.

"The market's looking a little oversold. It came under pressure at yesterday's close. One player was leaning on it quite heavily so it was probably five cents below what it should have been," one trader said.
Few players expected much activity ahead of the NYMEX open. July NYMEX crude was 11 cents higher at $18.79 a barrel in ACCESS trading.
Brokers said the main focus for the market was the American Petroleum Institute (API) oil stock data due out late on Tuesday.
Last week the data showed that crude oil stocks grew 8.44 million barrels in the week ending May 30, distillate stocks rose 5.09 million barrels and gasoline stocks were up 261,000 barrels.
Traders said gas oil had risen in the wake of Brent's gains.
